balls.text: gone, caught this time, Jadeja has holed out to the deep square-leg region and Chennai end on 164/5. 18 from that over and a wicket.
drilled down to long-on and the fielder was very straight this time, only a single.
pitched right into the block-hole and guess what the captain does, coolly flicks it away to the leg-side, with a lot of power from his bottom-hand and that is gone.
helicopter shot, not too much of a back-lift, and yes, this has, without exaggeration, cleared the roof.
short ball and that is pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shot, six! That was right in the slot and Jadeja has dismissed the first ball he faces out of the park.
yes it will, that is drilled so hard from Dhoni that Nehra will be thanking his stars that his head wasn't close to the ball. No chance for the long-on fielder either and that's gone for four.
out, caught! Pitched outside the off-stump, Bravo plays his favourite inside-out stroke, but the ball carries only up to the sweeper fielder, where Mathews takes his third catch!
hits hard to long-off and if the shot was good then the running between the wickets was amazing. They came back for the second.
pitching outside the leg-stump, tried to flick it away but fails to get any bat, an unnecessary shout for an lbw by Nehra.
pitched right up to the bat and Dhoni hits a half-helicopter stroke, drilled to long-on for a single.
finally something to cheer about for the Super Kings that over. Short and it was smacked away over long-on for a six. 12 off the over, six off the first five balls.
outside the off-stump and Bravo had given himself so much room that he failed to get to it.
driven to the off-side, they go for a risky single, Pandey tried to throw the stumps down from extra-cover, he missed it and they got an overthrow.
defends on the back-foot to the off-side
pitched outside the leg-stump and Dhoni tapped it to the leg-side and was immediately away for a single. He wanted a second but did not get it.
shorter one and that is cut away to the third-man region for three. That was extremely well run by the captain.
pitched outside the off-stump, up to the bat and Dhoni thumps it away to wide long-on for a four.  Many more of those needed after two relatively quieter overs.
dabbed on the off-stump and Dhoni was off. Bravo had some doubts about that single but Dhoni had none and a single results.
on the leg-stump and Dhoni nudges it away for a single
short ball to Raina and he continues to get out to bouncers! This time though he had no option but to go after the pull and the top-edge carries to Kartik at fine-leg and they have lost their third.
goes for a swipe, gets an outside edge and it flies off to the third-man for a single
pitched up to the bat, punched off the back-foot to long-off for a couple of runs.
slower, outside the off-stump and Raina attempt to cut is nothing more than a swish, beaten outside the off-stump.
tries to slog sweep it away, lofts it in the air and the ball finds the same fielder as before, Badri is gone and Chennai are suddenly two down.
looks to paddle-sweep but does not get the bat to the ball.
slower this time and du Plessis has spooned it up in the air on the leg-side, the fielder at the deep square-leg comes in and judges it really well.
into the block-hole, 108 km/hr and dug out.
full-toss and that is pulled away for a single. He is missing out on some full-tosses.
on the pads and the pull stroke is played away to the leg-side for a single.
bouncer and Badri tries to upper cut it, misses and that is a dot for a change.
that will go for another four, and it is not off the middle at all! He tried to hit it over square-leg, gets an outside edge and that goes to third-man for a four
pitched up to the bat, on the leg-side and the ball has been deposited to wide long-on for a four!
pulled it away, short ball and finally Badrinath gets it away to the fence. No chance for the fielder at fine-leg.

dropped! hoicked away on the leg-side and Ganguly had a chance to catch it, although he had a lot of ground to make, got some hand to it, but failed to catch it. He seems to have done his shoulder, he is taking his time getting up here.
tries to smoke it over mid-wicket but the under-edge gets him a single, 11 off the over and we have a Time-Out now.
status quo, down the track as always but gets it for a single to long-off.
down the track and for the first time he gets it in the middle of the bat and it goes over the long-on fielder for a six!
swats it away to the long-on fielder for a single.
down the pitch, mis-hit and the ball goes in the gap between long-off and sweeper for a couple.
missed stumping! went down the crease, missed it and Uthappa behind the stumps missed the ball and dislodged the bails without having the ball in his hands.

goes down, tries to crunch it through the covers, but goes to the fielder, who throws it back to the wicket-keeper. The batsman was out of his crease when the throw came in but the question is whether he was out when the bails were dislodged...the umpire has given it not-out! That is a surprise!
this time Badri clears his feet and gets the ball on the full, but the hit goes only over the bowler for a single.
repeats the routine, shimmy, down the pitch, gets it somewhere on the leg-side, single.
cut away to the sweeper for a couple of runs, to get Faff to his second half-century of the tournament.
and Badri goes down the track in an attempt to get to the pitch of the ball, but can only get it away for a single.
short from Rahul Sharma and it is pulled away for a single.
and the routine continues, shimmy down the pitch, drive to long-on and a single results.
he continues to go down the pitch and this time he flicks the quicker one from Samuels for a couple.
and he tries to go down the track yet again, this time, it takes the bottom edge of the bat and goes between the wicket-keeper's legs through to the fence.
pitched right up to the batsman and he comes forward and drives to long-on.
flicked away down the leg-side for a single
short of length and he tries to cut it, misses the edge of the bat and the keeper collects it.
this time he rocks on to the back-foot and whips it to the leg-side for a single. Six singles in that over.
inside-edge off a ball shorter in length and it is a single
du Plessis continues to walk down the pitch and drives it to long-on for a single.
full-toss and pulled away for a single.
goes down the pitch, a touch short and it was slashed to sweeper for a single.
goes down the track and does not get too much bat on it, goes to the deep mid-wicket region.
tried to paddle-sweep it, misjudged the line, the ball was way outside the off-stump and the realisation is a tad late, tries to change the stroke but by then it is too late and he is beaten.
gives himself a bit of room, then drives it through the covers for a single
slower one from Nehra as he saw du Plessis coming down the track, driven to long-off.
another one short from Nehra and it is pulled away to the deep square-leg fielder for a single. Ryder fields and throws in one motion.
short one from Nehra and it hurries on to the batsman, who tries to go for a pull, but fails to connect.
pulled away but it falls just short of the fielder at short mid-wicket, Ganguly was the fielder.
he drives it down the ground yet again and takes a single. 1 off his first over, 9 off his second.
again down the track in a flash, bowler shortened his length and that was driven to the leg-side for a couple of runs.
down the ground and du Plessis has finally managed to get some runs off Sharma. He drove uppishly through the extra-cover region for a four.
fullish to Badri, who goes down on his knees and drives it through the covers for a single.
tries to go down the track in order to get to the pitch of the ball, but can only nudge it away to the leg-side.
this time he drifts down the leg-side and it looked like it came off the pads.
it was an attempted yorker, but it turned out to be a well pitched-up delivery, Badri went down on his knees and drilled it to wide long-on for a four.
pitched right up to the batsman and driven straight to long-off.
driven down the ground at long-on, should have been a single but Murali Kartik misfielded and the batsmen were able to come back for the second run.
slower one, timed well by Badri but goes straight down to the fielder at long-off for a single.
pitched right up to the bat and he digs it out to the off-side.
paddle-swept away for the fence, it was outside the off-stump and the batsman took his front-foot away from the off-stump and got the ball to the fine-leg region.

pulls the length back again, allowing the batsman to go for the cut that lands straight into the hands of the point fielder, on the bounce though and that is the end of an excellent over from Rahul Sharma.
this time he pitches it right up to the batsman and du Plessis drives it straight to extra-cover.
bounce yet again and beats the batsman outside the off-stump.
on the middle-stump and the batsman needs to defend it there
outside the off-stump again and the batsman wanted to cut it away, beats the under-edge and through to the wicket-keeper
just outside the off-stump, a bit of bounce and Badri tries to late-cut it away, gets it away for a single only
slower one and Badri goes for a lofted pull, does not get too much of a bat there and only a single results.
goes down the pitch yet again and in an attempt to probably bowl it quicker, the bowler has over-stepped. Single for the batsman brings the non-striker to striker and earns him a Free Hit!
uses his feet, goes down the track and threads the gap between extra-cover and mid-off, this is excellent foot-work from the South African!
a tad quicker from Kumar and it jags back into the batsman, hurries du Plessis into the stroke and it hits his pads.
and du Plessis shows his form by skipping down the pitch and depositing it over the long-on region for a six! The first of the innings and the run-rate has also jumped up over six.
shimmies down the pitch and plays it to the leg-side for a single.
tries to paddle sweep the medium-pacer over the short mid-wicket fielder but does not get too much bat to it.
flicked to the leg-side but the short mid-wicket fielder dives and prevents a single. That's 11 from the over.
nudged away to the right of the short mid-wicket region for a single.
driven by du Plessis for a single to long-on too. Finally some momentum.
punches it down to long-on for a single.
short this time, quicker and Badri finally gets the cut into the gap, getting him his second successive four. Almost seemed like he was waiting for it.
this was slower from Samuels and Badri picked it up early and lifts him over the mid-off fielder for a four.
edged again, but this time it is a thicker one and the ball speeds away to the third-man fence for a four!

dropped! Murali Kartik has spilled a difficult chance, du Plessis went down the track yet again and went for a drive and the ball takes the outside edge, Kartik was fielding at wide slip and he needed to dive to his left, hits his palm and spills.
clips it away to the leg-side and they run away for a couple of runs. du Plessis was calling for the second very early...
and this time, there is ample bounce, goes down the track and the extra bounce surprises him, drops his wrists quickly down.
goes down the pitch and drives through extra-cover for a couple of runs. Some respite after only three off the last two overs.
Ooooh! The ball stays low yet again and du Plessis needed to really bend the bat down!
another one within the stumps and Badri goes for another cut, and once more, it goes to the fielder!
Badrinath is trying his best to get used to opening here and could just have been run-out here, cut away from the stumps and was off, sent back by the non-striker and he just makes it.
goes down the pitch and takes it on the full, drives to mid-on, no run.
on the middle stump, a little quicker and tapped away to the off-side.
pitched outside the leg-stump and that turned and bounce away from the batsman, well-kept by Uthappa, who collects and whips the bails off. Third-umpire called after much deliberation. Not-out.
on the stumps and it stayed a tad low, nudges it to the leg-side for a single.
length ball on off stump, down to third man for a single
a false shot from Badrinath, he was early into that as he chips it towards mid-on, it was pitched up and just outside off
a bouncer on leg stump, cramped up Badrinath, who managed to sway out of the path of that one, dropped the hands as well, 138kph
length ball is punched towards mid-on, a hint of swing for Nehra
inside-edged on to the pads, and the ball rolls towards slip
outside off and through to the keeper
crunched towards point off the back foot, in the air for a bit but lands well short of the fielder
tossed up, pitched up on middle and leg, clipped towards middle and leg
gets on the back foot, backs away from the stumps to make room, Badrinath slaps this past backward point for a boundary
short of length ball outside off, bottom edged to the off side
the crowd roars as Chennai and du Plessis get off the mark, a leg stump ball is worked towards square leg
the first ball is defended towards point by du Plessis
slower ball, gets an edge to third-man and Chennai have avenged their defeat at the hands of Pune in the previous game.
short and wide and it is called wide by the umpire.
full pitched once more and it is drilled away to the sweeper by Kartik for only a single. Right so, for a change we have seen two good overs, the penultimate and the last.
full-toss and played away to the wide long-off for a couple

full-toss, collision, football, it was all happening there! Full-toss, not above waist height though and they want to take a quick single, Bravo rushes off, kicks the ball on to the stumps, misses but collides with Kartik...who falls away...
pitched right up, yorker-length and Kartik manages to get some bat to it and is off for a single

full-toss, leg-side and that should have been flicked away to the leg-side for a four. The fine-leg was inside the ring, but Mathews seemed surprised by that delivery and misses getting any bat on it, the leg-stump lies flat on the ground.
full-toss and it is slashed away to the deep cover region for a run...scratch that, Mathews refuses the single to take strike in the last over.
shorter one from the bowler and Mathews wanted to slam it over mid-wicket but does not get any elevation. Excellent over so far, four off it and a wicket.
yorker and dug out well by Kumar, dabbed away to the off-side for a single
outside the off-stump and it is whacked away to the long-on fielder for a single
gone, caught! Pitched right up to the bat and Smith goes for the big one, gets a lot of height and du Plessis balances himself well at long-on and catches it rather well!
outside the off-stump, a tad slower and driven to the off-side for a single. 24 needed off 11 now...another last over finish
walks into his shot, turns the ball into a full-toss and drives to the covers for a single.
opens the phase of the bat and that is driven through the in-field, the sweeper fielder runs towards his left and manages to keep the ball in play
played away to the off-side for a single
full-toss and that is hit well to the long-on, Raina struggles to field it thanks to the dew and then Steve Smith at the non-striker's end slips as well.
yorker, turns out to be a full-toss and he drives it to long-on for a single
pitched right up to the bat, Smith wanted to drive to the off-side but the inside-edge goes to mid-wicket where the batsmen easily run two.
on the middle-stump, the batsman wanted to slog it away to leg-side but can get only a single
almost a yorker and Smith fails to get it away. Back to the bowler.
on the leg-side and nudged away to the deep square-leg region for a single
gives himself room, Mathews goes for a swipe on the leg-side, good running between the two puts pressure on Saha and he misfields.
varying his length, pitched fuller and Smith wants to go over the long-off, fails to get too much of a connection
down the track, Jadeja shortens his length and the drive goes to long-off for a single
shorter this time, going away from the bat and Mathews taps and runs on the off-side. 41 needed from 24, 17 came off that last over.
pitched right up yet again and that is played out to long-on for a single
driven to the leg-side for a quick single
that is a poor delivery, outside the leg-stump, beats both, the stumps and the wicket-keeper and it goes for four wides! Dhoni shows his frustration...
Mathews takes advantage of the Free Hit and sends the ball through mid-wicket region for a four.
plays it to the leg-side and the batsman gets another single, but surprise, surprise it is a no-ball and a Free Hit!
pitched up and driven to long-on for a single
slower and pitched full, Mathews taps it to the leg-side for a run. And then they run away for a second run as well...
played to the leg-side and that single gets them seven runs.
much shorter, played it away to point for a single
on his pads and nudged away to the leg-side for a single.
outside the off-side and knocked it away to off-side
short, and punched to wide long-on for a single

driven to long-on where Faff du Plessis gathers it well and throws it to the non-striker's end where the stumps are dislodged off a direct hit and a huge appeal follows. The batsman was just in, good running!
another one pitched up, tapped to the off side for a single
tosses it right to the batsman, who wants to drive it through the covers but its back to the bowler
works it away from outside the off-stump for a single to the leg
outside the off-stump and a tad shorter than what the captain would like from him, Mathews plays it away on the off-side for a single
gone, caught! flighted, slower one and Samuels looked in an aggressive frame of mind, went for a smashing drive, but it goes straight to the fielder at short cover.
outside the off-stump, pitched up and driven to the leg-side for a single
on Smith's pads, tries to play it away but gets it on the pads and they rush off for a leg-bye.
deft placement to third-man for a couple of runs. It was a late-cut, or a late-guide but Ashwin did well to field that.
drifts into his pads but Samuels does not take advantage of it, hits the pads and gets a leg-bye

run-out chance missed! Samuels cut it to the point fielder, Smith went for the single and the striker decided that there was no run in it. Jadeja went for the direct hit at the non-striker's end but missed.
short, top-edge and for most portion of the journey that ball undertook, it looked like it was going into the fielder's hands. Instead it carries over the fine-leg fence for a six!
pitched outside and up to the bat, driven to long-on for a single
Samuels has taken another couple of steps down the pitch and the ball has been sent over the bowler's head for a four. No chance for either long-on or long-off...13 off the over
shot back to the bowler, no run this time
goes down the track and drills it long-off, midfield allows them to come back for a couple
shorter from Jakati, wider too and Samuels was waiting in his crease, cuts it away for a four through point
fullish from Jakati and Samuels goes down the track and smashes it long-on, Ashwin comes around and saves a couple.
shorter, outside the off-stump and Smith punches it through the covers for a single
flicked away to the leg-side for a single.
down the leg-side, Smith tries to flick it away but gets no bat on it and they earn themselves a wide.
pitched up and driven back to the bowler
down the track, gets some bounce and hits the batsman on his back pad, runs away for a leg-bye
pitched right up to the batsman, who was on his back-foot, probably expecting it to be short, driven in the air but away from the fielder
outside the off-stump and he caresses it to the off-side. They get a single and a bit of a misfield allows him to come back for the second
almost a caught and a bowled, flick attempted, gets a leading edge to the right of Jadeja, but fails to get close to it.
driven back to the bowler, a bit of a misfield and there is a single for the batsman.
pitched outside the off-stump and spinning away from the bat

out, caught! Ganguly wanted to go down the track and Jakati seemed to have read that, bowled it a little short, Ganguly still went for it but only lobbed straight up and Kulasekara at mid-off took a good catch.
goes down the track and can only get an inside edge to it
shorter, a bit of turn but more vitally some bounce and it beats the outside edge
left arm round, angles into the bat and Samuels is able to nudge it away to the deep field on the leg-side
on his pads, flicks it away and wanted a single, Samuels sends him back and that will be the Time-Out
fullish from the bowler, and it is driven back to the bowler. Jadeja fields off his bowling.
this time he drives it through the leg-side in-field for a run.
pitched right up to the bat, who drives it to the leg-side
around the wicket, angling into the bat and defended away.
shorter and played away to deep square-leg for a single
short outside the off-stump and punched to long-on for a single.
quicker, shorter and outside the off-stump, played away to the off-side towards point.
shorter from Jakati, Samuels goes on to his back-foot and smashes it to the sweeper region for a single.
moves towards the bowler and flicks it away to the leg-side for a single.
shorter, goes through without turn, Samuels thought it would spin away and the inside-edge gets him a single.
pitched up and defended back to the bowler.
bouncer to test Ganguly, who goes down under it well. End of a good, successful over from Bravo, couple of runs and a wicket.
short of length and Samuels plays it away to third-man for a single
pitched right up to the batsman and Samuels defends it back to the bowler.
this time he manages to get the late cut to third-man for a single
defended on the off-side, wanted to get it through the third-man but du Plessis dives and sends Ganguly back.

out, caught and a good one too! Pitched right up to the bat, Pandey wanted to go over the extra-cover, the ball ballooned up but Badri needed to run a fair distance to get to the ball and he did that, caught it and held on to it even as he was falling away. Excellent catch.
another four! What a shot! Ganguly's getting back into some batting form, this time he has flicked it to the square-leg region for another four
pitched up and Ganguly goes on to his back-foot and flicks it through the fine-leg region for a four!

on the back-foot and punched to the mid-off, went for a quick single, and fielder tries to get a run-out at the non-striker's end. The ball misses the stumps and Jakati comes in from the deep and fails to back the throw up...goes for overthrows!
room again and Ganguly tries to give himself room yet again, this time it is jagging into his body and he manages to squeeze it through to mid-wicket for a single
expected that short one and even before it is bowler, he has got himself into position, gets inside the ball and uses the pace of the ball to pull it over the short fine-leg for a four.
short, Ganguly gives himself some room and tries to cut it through the covers, but its straight to the fielder.
pitched right up again, Ashwin is bowling a tad quicker, it was right in the slot for the batsman who went for the lofted drive over mid-on. Goes all the way!
drifts down the leg-side, flicked away to the deep square-leg region and they get an easy couple of runs.
the get-out shot, sweep and that hits the pads and trickles away for a single.
defends on the front-foot yet again
gives himself room, tries to cut away but its straight to the cover fielder.
defends it back to the bowler
outside the off-stump, good length and Pandey lets it go through to the keeper.
on the middle-stump and defended back to the bowler.
short, pull, caught and dance! It was not pitched up by Nuwan, Ryder went for the pull, Bravo dived in front of him and then began a jig that would have brought a smile to everyone watching!
tries to pull it away but it climbs a tad on him and sends his timing awry.
and then he follows it up with a very good shot, driven with a full face of the bat, through the left of mid-on and it rushes quickly to the fence. The run-rate is a decent one to begin with.
ugly swipe to a good length ball and that misses the bat and the stumps.
sweep again and this time Ganguly gets ample of bat to it and the ball runs to its destination by the name of the boundary
short and Ganguly wants to cut it away, gets it only up to cover fielder.
despite those two fielders in close, he drifts down the leg-side and Ganguly sweeps, gets some pad and there are a couple of leg-byes
slower in the air but shorter too, Ryder had gone through his shot before getting a bit of an edge there and they are off.
darts into the batsman and Ryder gets some bat on to it.
drives it through to point for no run.
nothing different from the previous ball, hit straight into the covers for no run.
punched to the off-side straight to the fielder.
short ball from Kulasekara and Ganguly swivel-pulls it over the infield. A couple of runs for Ganguly.
on the off-stump and Ganguly drives it to the off-side

gone, caught! Dhoni came up, Robin remained in the crease, still tried to go over the top, did not get it in the middle of the bat and it lobbed up behind the bowler, Ashwin rushed in from mid-off to take a very good catch.
pitched up on the off-stump and driven over mid-off for a four. It was done beautifully done, so much so that Uthappa held that pose for some time.
pitched right up and driven to mid-on.
and this is an excellent comeback! Short again but this time it was into the body, Ryder wanted to dab it to the off-side, cramped him for room and hits him on the chest.
whoa, first ball, first four! Ryder is in good form but this is excellent batting. Shortish and Ryder pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a four! It was more a jab
on the leg-stump, quick delivery, Uthappa nudges it to the leg-side and rushes off for a first and wants a second. Ryder refuses and one is all they will get.
and this is pitched further up, Uthappa tried to drive, got an edge, missed the slip, missed the third-man and goes for a four.
outside the off-stump, on the length and Uthappa tries to dab it away to third-man, but goes on the bounce to the slip.
